description: Media source records for audio, video, image, document, signal, motion, and volume data associated with expressions. Modality-specific metadata is factored into composable object types (audioInfo, videoInfo, documentInfo, imageInfo, signalInfo, eyeTrackingInfo, motionInfo, volumeInfo) so that multimodal media can carry all relevant technical metadata.

main.description: A media source record (audio, video, image, document, signal, motion, or volume) that can be referenced by expressions and annotations. Modality-specific metadata lives in composable info objects; a single medium may carry several (a motion stream also carries signalInfo).

kindUri.description: AT-URI of the media kind definition node (typeDef of `media-kind` at layers-core.ontology.layers.pub). Names the carrier; the instrument-level modality is named by signalInfo.modalityUri, whose nodes reach their carrier node by parentTypeRef. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

kind.description: Media kind slug (fallback when kindUri unavailable). Names the CARRIER only. The instrument is named by signalInfo.modalityUri, which resolves into the same node set as pub.layers.judgment.defs#recordingMethod.methodUri; one media kind per instrument would fork that vocabulary across two lexicons.

blob.description: The media blob. Signal, motion and volume containers (EDF, BDF, FIF, EEGLAB SET, BrainVision, SNIRF, NWB, NIfTI, ASC, C3D, TRC) travel as application/octet-stream or application/x-hdf5, with the concrete container named by the relevant info block's format field. Content above maxSize MUST use externalUri.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the carried bytes.

durationNanos.description: Duration in nanoseconds; authoritative over durationMs where both are present. Milliseconds round away whole samples at 2048 Hz and above.

parentMediaRef.description: AT-URI of the parent media record this excerpt/clip was extracted from.

startOffsetMs.description: Offset in milliseconds where this excerpt starts within the parent media. Used with parentMediaRef.

audio.description: Audio-specific metadata. Present for audio files and videos with audio tracks.

video.description: Video-specific metadata. Present for video files and image sequences.

document.description: Document-specific metadata. Present for scanned documents, manuscripts, etc.

image.description: Still-image metadata. Photographs previously had to borrow videoInfo.

signal.description: Sampled time-series metadata (EEG, MEG, iEEG, fNIRS, EMG, ECG, EDA, respiration, gaze, mouse and key logging).

eyeTracking.description: Eye-tracking specifics, carried alongside signal. A nested block rather than an eighth carrier kind, because BIDS types eye-tracking as a physiological recording.

motion.description: Motion-capture and articulography metadata, carried alongside signal.

contentDigest.description: Hash over the referenced bytes. The only integrity guarantee available for externalUri carriage, and therefore expected whenever externalUri is used without a blob. A record CID pins the record, not the bytes behind a URI.

sessionRef.description: AT-URI of the pub.layers.acquisition.session this medium is a stream of. Every stream of one synchronized recording carries the same sessionRef. parentMediaRef expresses excerpt-of and MUST NOT be used for synchronization.

stream.description: The session stream this medium fills, as an objectRef whose recordRef is sessionRef and whose objectId is the stream's uuid. Replaces a session-local label string: a name join cannot be validated and cannot be detected as dangling.

sync.description: How this stream aligns to its session's shared time base.

participantRefs.description: AT-URIs of the pub.layers.acquisition.participant records this recording captures. On the record rather than inside four sibling info blocks, because a speech recording and a face video capture participants too, and four copies with no precedence rule is a conflict waiting to be written.

access.description: Conditions under which the bytes may be obtained. Distinct from licensing, which governs what may be done with them, and from consent, which governs the person they came from. All three must hold.

licensing.description: Distribution licensing terms governing this media (supports dual/multi/component licensing). Canonical license for the media; the consent.license feature, when present, records per-clip consent terms.

eprintRefs.description: Eprint records (papers/preprints) describing or associated with this media.

metadata.description: Provenance: who created/uploaded this media record, with what tool.

features.description: Open-ended features: recording conditions, speaker metadata, quality metrics, consent, etc.

createdAt.description: Timestamp at which this media record was created.

languages.description: BCP-47 language tags this record covers. Empty when language is unspecified or unknown.

languageRefs.description: Structured language references, for varieties a BCP-47 tag cannot name. Each entry's tag SHOULD also appear in languages.
